notes: colourMatik 1.7.6 — sees your clips exactly as Premiere does. A deep audit of the whole colour pipeline (decode, engine, panel, native effect) against real footage found and fixed: untagged clips (all AI-generated footage) were decoded through a BT.601 matrix while Premiere uses BT.709, skewing greens and skin on both sides of every match; speed-changed clips sampled the wrong frame for 'match this frame'; failed matches could silently leave an unapproved draft grade on the clip; previews of playhead matches showed only the top strip of the frame; plus HDR tone-mapping on decode, a stale gallery frame-time leak, and several smaller correctness holes.
